_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Locations.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Chinese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "chinese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, pinyin, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "chinese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

Club_CalicoJack.chinese: 想玩 21 点吗？这是 100 硬币赌注的赌桌。
Club_CalicoJack.english: Want to play 21 points? This is the 100-coin-bet table.

Club_CalicoJackHS_NotEnoughCoins.chinese: 你至少需要 1000 硬币才能在这里玩。
Club_CalicoJackHS_NotEnoughCoins.english: You need at least 1000 coins to play here.

Club_CalicoJack_HS.chinese: 这一桌是下大注的。每次下注是 1000 硬币。
Club_CalicoJack_HS.english: This table is for big bets. Each bet is 1000 coins.

Club_CalicoJack_NotEnoughCoins.chinese: 哎，固定投注是 100 个硬币。你没有足够的硬币。想玩的话请到机器那里购买硬币。
Club_CalicoJack_NotEnoughCoins.english: Hey, the fixed bet is 100 coins. You don't have enough coins. If you want to play, please go to the machine over there to buy coins.

Club_CalicoJack_Rules1.chinese: 游戏的目的是尽可能接近 21 点。牌从 1 点至 9 点不等，除了第一张牌可能是高达11点以外。每个玩家一开始会获得两张牌，但庄家的第一张牌是隐藏牌。每回合你可选择抽一张 1 点到 9 点之间的随机牌，或者选择放弃该轮抽牌。
Club_CalicoJack_Rules1.english: The goal of the game is to get as close to 21 points as possible. Cards range from 1 to 9 points, except that the first card may be as high as 11 points. Each player starts with two cards, but the dealer's first card is a hidden card. Each round you can choose to draw a random card between 1 and 9 points, or choose to give up drawing this round.

Club_CalicoJack_Rules2.chinese: 一旦你放弃抽牌，庄家隐藏的牌会被亮出。庄家必须抽到总数等于或大于 18 点。如果任何一个玩家超过 21 点，那么他们就输了。如果庄家放弃抽牌，那么所有的牌都会被亮出，点数最高者获胜。
Club_CalicoJack_Rules2.english: Once you give up drawing, the dealer's hidden card will be revealed. The dealer must draw until the total is equal to or greater than 18 points. If any player exceeds 21 points, then they lose. If the dealer gives up drawing, then all the cards will be revealed, and the one with the highest points wins.

FieldOfficeDonated_0.chinese: 啊……这块东西记录的自然历史真是令人着迷！谢谢你。
FieldOfficeDonated_0.english: Ah... the natural history this piece records is truly fascinating! Thank you.

FieldOfficeDonated_1.chinese: 完美！这骨头正是我要找的。来，让我擦一下放大镜……
FieldOfficeDonated_1.english: Perfect! This bone is exactly what I'm looking for. Come, let me wipe the magnifying glass...

FieldOfficeDonated_2.chinese: 你真是太棒了，@。这是我见过的保存最完好的标本之一，谢谢你！$h
FieldOfficeDonated_2.english: You are really too great, @. This is one of the best-preserved specimens I've seen, thank you!

FieldOfficeDonated_3.chinese: 你想想……几代人在这块土地上来了又走，而这根小小的骨头却始终藏在土里。而现在它是我的了！
FieldOfficeDonated_3.english: Think about it... generations came and went on this land, while this little bone stayed hidden in the soil all along. And now it's mine!

FieldOfficeDonated_Reward.chinese: 看看！加上你拿过来的部位，我们又凑齐了一整套骨头。$h#$b#我在柜台后面给你准备了些小东西，你有空就来拿！
FieldOfficeDonated_Reward.english: Look! Adding the parts you brought, we've gathered another complete set of bones. I've prepared some little things for you behind the counter, come get them when you have time!

Forest_HatMouseStore_Abandoned.english: It seems this place was long since abandoned...

Forest_OpenedSewer.chinese: 你使用生锈的钥匙打开了下水道的井盖！
Forest_OpenedSewer.english: You used the rusty key to open the sewer's manhole cover!

Forest_WizardTower_Locked.chinese: 虽然上锁了，但你听见里面有人。
Forest_WizardTower_Locked.english: Although it's locked, you hear someone inside.

Gil_Telephone.chinese: 嗨。搞定了 150 只熔岩精灵？真是厉害。#$b#那么……我会给你马龙的电话号码，他不喜欢我把这个告诉别人，但我觉得这是你应得的。#$b#如果你需要使用物品恢复服务，但又不想跑到这里来……给我们打个电话就行了。听起来不错吧？

If you need to use the item recovery service but don't want to run over here... just give us a call. Sounds good, right?

Gourmand_Finished.chinese: 咯哩哩哩……李又来了，biu 滴朋友。|希望李还在种辣些 biu 大的果子，小子！
Gourmand_Finished.english: Ribbit... you've come again, my good friend. Hope you're still growing those big fruits, kid!

Gourmand_InProgress.chinese: 啊……窝看到李种辣个东西了。但是现在还是咻~小。等长到 biu 大了再来吧……
Gourmand_InProgress.english: Ah... I see you're growing that thing. But right now it's still very small. Come back when it's grown big...

Gourmand_Intro.chinese: 咯哩哩哩……是谁？李就是辣个在窝房子外面种地的农民吗，小子？
Gourmand_Intro.english: Ribbit... who is it? Are you the farmer who farms outside my house, kid?

Gourmand_LastReward.chinese: 咯哩哩哩……太好了……窝全都想起来了！|谢谢李唤醒窝这么多回忆。|最后给李一个好东西，小子。
Gourmand_LastReward.english: Ribbit... wonderful... I remember it all now! Thank you for awakening so many memories in me. One last good thing for you, kid.

Gourmand_RequestFailed.chinese: 咯哩哩哩……李没有种窝想要的辣个东西……种上兹后再来早窝……
Gourmand_RequestFailed.english: Ribbit... you didn't grow that thing I want... come find me after you've planted it...

Gourmand_RequestIntro.chinese: 呼噜噜……辣个土地以前新鲜滴吃滴可多嘞……唉……要四棱再有辣么多吃滴就好了。
Gourmand_RequestIntro.english: Gurgle... that land used to have so much fresh food... sigh... if only there could be that much to eat again.

Gourmand_RequestQuestion.chinese: 小子，李在外面种辣个东西吗？
Gourmand_RequestQuestion.english: Kid, are you growing that thing outside?

Gourmand_Request_0.chinese: 李给窝种……辣个粉红色的东西……多兹的辣个……
Gourmand_Request_0.english: Grow for me... that pink thing... that very juicy one...

Gourmand_Request_0_Success.chinese: 呼噜噜……就是辣个。biu 粉红色滴……biu 多兹的……|……浪窝回想起过去的时候啊……阳光很大，东西很甜……|（哧溜）……窝想要次一口 biu 多兹的……|……不，窝就算了。
Gourmand_Request_0_Success.english: Gurgle... that's the one. So pink... so juicy... It makes me recall the past... the sun was strong, things were sweet... (slurp)... I want to take a bite of the juicy one... no, I'll forget it.

Gourmand_Request_1.chinese: 窝想要看到辣个长的、黄色的、挠痒痒滴东西……辣个在风中摇晃滴东西……
Gourmand_Request_1.english: I want to see that long, yellow, tickly thing... that thing swaying in the wind...

Gourmand_Request_1_Success.chinese: 呼噜噜……不错。biu 长滴，跑过去的时候……biu 挠痒痒。|嘿嘿……浪窝想起了窝的前女友……（呼噜）……|嘿嘿……现在窝想给李挠痒痒……|……不，窝就算了。
Gourmand_Request_1_Success.english: Gurgle... not bad. So long, when you run past it... so tickly. Hehe... it makes me think of my ex-girlfriend... (gurgle)... Hehe... now I want to tickle you... no, I'll forget it.

Tunnel_TunnelSafe_ConsumeBattery.english: It worked! The safe opened. Inside there is a note:

Tunnel_TunnelSafe_Initial.chinese: 这是一个电池供电的保险箱。可惜的是，没上电池。
Tunnel_TunnelSafe_Initial.english: This is a battery-powered safe. Unfortunately, no battery is installed.

Tunnel_TunnelSafe_MrQiNote.chinese: “你的第一个任务：带一个彩虹贝壳到火车站台。把贝壳放进箱子里。——齐先生”
Tunnel_TunnelSafe_MrQiNote.english: "Your first task: bring a rainbow shell to the train platform. Put the shell into the box. -- Mr. Qi"

Volcano_ShortcutOut.english: Take the shortcut to leave the volcano?

WitchHut_EvilShrineCenter.chinese: ——记忆之黑暗神殿——^你和你配偶之间的一切记忆将会被抹除。就像你们俩从未邂逅过一样。^是否确定献祭 30,000 金？
WitchHut_EvilShrineCenter.english: Dark Shrine of Memory. All memories between you and your spouse will be erased. Just as if you two had never met. Are you sure you want to offer 30,000 gold?

WitchHut_EvilShrineCenterInactive.chinese: ——记忆之黑暗神殿——^雕像的锐利眼神透视你的身体……
WitchHut_EvilShrineCenterInactive.english: Dark Shrine of Memory. The statue's sharp gaze sees through your body...

WitchHut_EvilShrineLeft.chinese: ——私欲之黑暗神殿——^你的孩子会变成鸽子飞走……^是否确定献祭一块五彩碎片？
WitchHut_EvilShrineLeft.english: Dark Shrine of Selfishness. Your children will turn into doves and fly away... Are you sure you want to offer a prismatic shard?

WitchHut_EvilShrineLeftInactive.chinese: ——私欲之黑暗神殿——^雕像的锐利眼神透视你的身体……
WitchHut_EvilShrineLeftInactive.english: Dark Shrine of Selfishness. The statue's sharp gaze sees through your body...

WitchHut_EvilShrineRightActivate.chinese: ——夜惊之黑暗神殿——^古老的魔法保护屏障会被撤走，怪物会在夜间出没你的农场。^是否确定献祭一个奇怪小包子？
WitchHut_EvilShrineRightActivate.english: Dark Shrine of Night Terrors. The ancient magic protective barrier will be withdrawn, and monsters will appear on your farm at night. Are you sure you want to offer a strange bun?

WitchHut_EvilShrineRightDeActivate.chinese: ——夜惊之黑暗神殿——^古老的魔法保护屏障会被恢复，防止怪物在夜间出没你的农场。^是否确定献祭一个奇怪小包子？
WitchHut_EvilShrineRightDeActivate.english: Dark Shrine of Night Terrors. The ancient magic protective barrier will be restored, preventing monsters from appearing on your farm at night. Are you sure you want to offer a strange bun?

WitchHut_NoOffering.english: You don't have the required offering.

WizardTower_WizardShrine.chinese: 是否花500金使用幻觉神龛改变你的外表？
WizardTower_WizardShrine.english: Spend 500 gold to use the Shrine of Illusions to change your appearance?

WomensLocker_WrongGender.chinese: 这是女更衣室……你不能进去！
WomensLocker_WrongGender.english: This is the women's changing room... you can't go in!

Woods_Statue.chinese:
--老师傅香炸奶酪卷--
……依旧寻求着最甜的味道……
Woods_Statue.english: Old Master Fragrant Fried Cheese Roll. ...still seeking the sweetest taste...

qiNutDoor.chinese: 你听到门后传来一个奇怪的声音……#“只有最强的核桃猎人才能进入。”^——你现在的进度：{0}/100
qiNutDoor.english: You hear a strange voice coming from behind the door... "Only the strongest walnut hunters can enter." Your current progress: {0}/100

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#1.chinese: 呵……这么多年过去了，这上面还有他的味道……#$b#……我再熟悉不过的腐烂恶臭……$h
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#1.english: Heh... so many years have passed, and it still has his smell on it... the rotten stench I couldn't know better...

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#2.chinese: 孩子……在这里过日子确实是非常孤独的。但我完全不后悔。#$b#我就在我的老头子身边……呵呵，我们马上就能又在一起了……
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#2.english: Child... life here truly is very lonely. But I don't regret it at all. I'm right by my old man's side... hehe, we'll soon be together again...

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#4.chinese: 他已经死了，你得有你自己的生活。
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#4.english: He's already dead; you must have your own life.

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#5.chinese: 你很聪明，孩子。#$b#你带给了我莫大的安宁……我的余生全因这块吊坠得到抚慰。$h
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#5.english: You're very wise, child. You've brought me enormous peace... the rest of my life will be entirely comforted by this locket.

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#6.chinese: 像我这样的老女人吗？我觉得已经太迟了，孩子……$s#$b#而且……我喜欢这里！这里令人放松，风景迷人，而且还有吃不完的鲜鱼、牡蛎，还有猴子肉。呵呵呵。$h#$b#……猴子肉是开玩笑的。
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#6.english: An old woman like me? I think it's already too late, child... And... I like it here! It's relaxing here, the scenery is charming, and there's endless fresh fish, oysters, and monkey meat. Hehehe. ...the monkey meat was a joke.

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#7.chinese: 现在……我该如何回报你呢？
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#7.english: Now... how should I repay you?

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#8.chinese: 啊……给你传授一份特别的制作方法如何，这是我在这待了这么多年研究出来的。
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#8.english: Ah... how about I pass on to you a special recipe; it's something I worked out over these many years staying here.

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#11.chinese: 虽然你一开始不认识我这老婆子，还是尽全力帮助了我。#$b#为你的善心献上祝福！$h
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieFinished#11.english: Although at first you didn't know me, this old woman, you still did your best to help me. Blessings for your kindness!

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieIntro#0.english: Oh... someone's come to visit? Come here, child.

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieIntro#1.chinese: 这儿已经好久没来过人了……$s#$b#我都快忘了别人长什么样了！
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieIntro#1.english: It's been a long time since anyone came here... I've almost forgotten what other people look like!

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieIntro#2.chinese: 嗯，既然你都到这了，我不妨请你帮个忙。
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieIntro#2.english: Well, since you've come here, I might as well ask you to do me a favor.

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieIntro#4.chinese: 你看到南岸那艘沉船了吗？#$b#我丈夫是那艘船的船长，他曾是个海盗。#$b#有一天他启航后就再也没有回来。我在公海上航行了三年才找到他的遗体。$s
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieIntro#4.english: Did you see that sunken ship on the south shore? My husband was that ship's captain; he was once a pirate. One day after he set sail he never came back again. I sailed the high seas for three years before finding his remains.

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieIntro#5.chinese: 唉……$s#$b#孩子，自那以后我就一直在这儿。$s#$b#……守卫他的遗骨。
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieIntro#5.english: Sigh... Child, since then I've been here all along. ...guarding his bones.

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieIntro#6.chinese: 孩子，如果我能找到他的纪念品，它将带给我莫大的安宁。$s
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieIntro#6.english: Child, if I could find a memento of his, it would bring me enormous peace.

IslandSecret_Event_BirdieIntro#8.chinese: 给你，拿上这个，这是一张被冲到岸上的旧照片。#$b#我能给你的只有这个了……不知道为什么，我就是觉得能帮助你找到我要的东西。
IslandSecret_Event_BirdieIntro#8.english: Here you go, take this, it's an old photo that was washed onto the shore. This is all I can give you... I don't know why, I just feel it can help you find the thing I want.

IslandHut_Event_ParrotBoyIntro#0.chinese: 男孩用好奇的眼神看着你……
IslandHut_Event_ParrotBoyIntro#0.english: The boy looks at you with curious eyes...

IslandHut_Event_ParrotBoyIntro#1.chinese: 他似乎与鹦鹉关系密切。
IslandHut_Event_ParrotBoyIntro#1.english: He seems to have a close relationship with the parrots.

IslandHut_Event_ParrotBoyIntro#2.chinese: 但他现在很怕生，不敢接近你。
IslandHut_Event_ParrotBoyIntro#2.english: But he is very shy of strangers now, and doesn't dare approach you.

IslandHut_Event_ParrotBoyIntro#3.chinese: 也许和鹦鹉交朋友可以赢得他的信任？
IslandHut_Event_ParrotBoyIntro#3.english: Perhaps making friends with the parrots can win his trust?

IslandFieldOffice_Intro_Event#2.chinese: 如你所见……这里很空。$s#$b#我被困在那个山洞里，所以项目没什么进展。$s
IslandFieldOffice_Intro_Event#2.english: As you see... it's very empty here. I was trapped in that cave, so the project didn't make much progress.

IslandFieldOffice_Intro_Event#3.chinese: 但这就是我叫你来的原因！嘿嘿……$h
IslandFieldOffice_Intro_Event#3.english: But this is the reason I called you here! Hehe...

IslandFieldOffice_Intro_Event#4.chinese: 是这样的，我是做骨头生意的……#$b#特别是古代的骨头……这个岛上正好到处都是。#$b#所以说，如果你在这个岛上找到什么骨头、化石、木乃伊标本，请把它们带过来，好吗？我会给你相应的报酬！$h
IslandFieldOffice_Intro_Event#4.english: It's like this, I'm in the bone business... especially ancient bones... which this island happens to be full of. So, if you find any bones, fossils, or mummy specimens on this island, please bring them over, okay? I'll give you a corresponding reward!

IslandNorth_Event_SafariManAppear#0.chinese: 谢谢你！我以为我死定了……$h#$b#我被困在这个山洞里几个月了！
IslandNorth_Event_SafariManAppear#0.english: Thank you! I thought I was dead for sure... I've been trapped in this cave for several months!

IslandNorth_Event_SafariManAppear#1.chinese: 要是再让我吃洞穴里的蘑菇沙拉我就得疯了……（打颤）……太难嚼了……$s
IslandNorth_Event_SafariManAppear#1.english: If I had to eat the cave's mushroom salad again I'd go mad... (shivers)... too hard to chew...

IslandNorth_Event_SafariManAppear#2.chinese: 是这样……我是蜗牛教授。#$b#去年我一直在调查这个岛上的动植物。这地方真的不得了！
IslandNorth_Event_SafariManAppear#2.english: It's like this... I'm Professor Snail. Last year I was surveying this island's animals and plants. This place is truly remarkable!

IslandNorth_Event_SafariManAppear#3.chinese: 嗯，我觉得我得先回帐篷收拾一下自己。我现在怕是闻起来跟蘑菇似的……$s#$b#嘿……你可以找个时间到帐篷来找我！像你这样有进取心的人可以成为我研究项目的主力人员……嘿嘿！再会。$h
IslandNorth_Event_SafariManAppear#3.english: Well, I think I need to go back to the tent first and tidy myself up. I'm afraid I now smell like mushrooms... Hey... you can come find me at the tent sometime! Someone enterprising like you could become a key member of my research project... hehe! Farewell.

alreadyGotNuts#0.chinese: 虽然你一开始不认识我这老婆子，还是尽全力帮助了我。#$b#为你的善心献上祝福！$h
alreadyGotNuts#0.english: Although at first you didn't know me, this old woman, you still did your best to help me. Blessings for your kindness!

FieldOfficeFinale#0.chinese: 哇……#$b#看看我们收集到了多少东西！$h
FieldOfficeFinale#0.english: Wow... Look how many things we've collected!

FieldOfficeFinale#1.chinese: 收集了这么多东西可太棒了，这都是你的功劳啊，@。
FieldOfficeFinale#1.english: Collecting so many things is really great, and it's all thanks to you, @.

FieldOfficeFinale#2.chinese: 这样吧，作为感谢，我想教你一些东西。
FieldOfficeFinale#2.english: How about this, as thanks, I want to teach you something.

FieldOfficeFinale#3.chinese: 已学会制作“鸵鸟孵化器”。

FieldOfficeFinale#4.chinese: 这个设备可以让你在家养鸵鸟。把孵化器放在畜棚里，放一个鸵鸟蛋进去，然后等待……
FieldOfficeFinale#4.english: This device lets you raise ostriches at home. Put the incubator in a barn, put an ostrich egg in, then wait...

FieldOfficeFinale#5.chinese: 不过，怎么拿到鸵鸟蛋就是另一回事了……这事还得你自己来！
FieldOfficeFinale#5.english: However, how to get an ostrich egg is another matter... that you'll have to do yourself!

FieldOfficeFinale#6.chinese: 哈哈……接下来真正的工作才刚要开始。#$b#我要用好几年的时间去研究这些骨头！
FieldOfficeFinale#6.english: Haha... next, the real work is only just starting. I'm going to spend many years studying these bones!

FieldOfficeFinale#7.english: If fate allows, we'll meet again, @!
